cohort: 232 pregnant women with COVID-19 referred to Mousavi Hospital in Zanjan City, Iran, between February 2020 and August 2021
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 experienced common symptoms like weakness, myalgia, dry cough, and fatigue, while lymphopenia and elevated CRP, ALT, D-Dimer, and LDH were common laboratory findings.
mod_finding: Mortality rates were 3% for vaginal deliveries and 6.1% for C-sections among COVID-19-infected mothers.
